data.text: Hey, yeah, so I've been without internet for like the past couple hours now. My modem's just showing all orange lights and I can't get anything to connect, so I'm calling from my phone right now.
I'll help you get to the bottom of this. Let me start by pulling up your account and running some diagnostics on your modem.

results.title: Modem Reboot Procedure
results.snippet: Reboot the modem when the customer reports: - No internet connection despite modem appearing powered on - Very slow speeds that did not improve after router restart

results.title: Slow Internet Speeds Troubleshooting
results.snippet: 1. **Weak modem signal** — downstream signal below -7 dBmV or above +7 dBmV indicates line issues. 2. **WiFi interference or distance** — 2.4 GHz band congestion; customer too far from router. 3. **Peak-hour congestion** — shared neighbourhood node oversubscribed in the evenings (6–10 PM).

results.title: WiFi vs. Ethernet — Troubleshooting Connectivity Differences
results.snippet: | Factor | Ethernet (wired) | WiFi (wireless) | |---|---|---| | Speed | Full subscribed tier | Up to 80% of tier (varies by band) |

<analysis>
**Diagnostic Summary:**

I've gathered the following evidence:

- **Customer Account** [tool:lookup_customer]: Jane Smith, active account since 2021, Gigabit 500 service tier, NETGEAR CM500 modem in the northeast (ZIP 10001).

- **Modem Status** [tool:check_modem_status]: The modem is technically online but in critical condition:
  - Downstream signal: –12 dBmV (well outside acceptable range; should be between –7 and +7 dBmV)
  - Upstream signal: 44 dBmV (also elevated)
  - **7 restarts in the last 24 hours** — indicates instability
  - Uptime only 0.5 hours — modem just restarted
  - Signal quality marked as "weak"
  - Firmware note flags "line issue"

- **Connectivity Test** [tool:ping_customer_modem]: High latency (287 ms) and 12.5% packet loss — consistent with a signal degradation problem.

- **ISP Outage Check** [tool:check_isp_outage]: No active outages in the customer's area.

- **KB Consultation** [kb:slow_speeds]: Downstream signal below –7 dBmV indicates a line issue (not WiFi or congestion).

**Diagnosis:** This is a **line-level signal problem**, not a software or outage issue. The orange lights, frequent restarts, weak signal levels, and high packet loss all point to a degraded connection between the ISP's network and the customer's modem. This typically requires a technician visit to check the cable line, splitters, or connections outside the home.
</analysis>
